entries.content: Demihumans are animal-human hybrids which lean more toward humans in their characteristics. They commonly only have somewhat minor animal traits such as animal ears, tails. They are considered to be of equivalent standing to humans, are able to interbreed with humans and take grave offense to being seen as less than human.
